attempts.summary: Implemented via Ansible from control node4: node2 serves an app on tcp/8080 (nginx), firewalled to accept 8080 only from node1's LAN IP. node1 (VyOS) terminates a WireGuard tunnel (wg0, 10.200.0.0/24) and applies a hairpin source-NAT rule that translates node3's tunnel-sourced traffic to node1's own LAN IP before it reaches node2, plus forward/input firewall rules that scope tunnel traffic to only node2:8080 and allow inbound UDP/51820. node3 runs a WireGuard client with AllowedIPs scoped to only node2's IP, so it reaches the app solely through the tunnel via node1; a forced direct-LAN attempt from node3 to node2:8080 is rejected. Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all four managed nodes, confirming changed boot_id and full functional recovery after each restart.
